observations: The single CoJ process reached normal outer run_end, but the live verifier rejected the run because no Sense select safely dismissed a frozen loading or hint UI.

The user could not skip startup videos or reliably activate menu options. The exact log cause was repeated dependence on GameWithMenu.sm_cMenuModule while that module was unavailable; shipped bytecode provides IntroModule.OnInputKey for videos and LawmanModule.cMenu for in-game menus.

The flat-theater cursor was visible, but there was no controller laser. The video shows the flat Escape/main-menu surface near the end and confirms that cursor visibility alone did not make the UI usable.

Walking and jumping felt jerky. Telemetry showed smooth analog action samples, while player reconciliation directly rewrote the actor for millimetre-scale HMD changes on most sampled frames, bypassing native collision and fighting locomotion.
The actor-yaw path applied hundreds of small RotateHorizontally updates. A comfort cone is required so ordinary head motion remains in the upper body and the actor turns only for wider sustained yaw.

The arms visibly moved away when the user turned their head in a T-pose. Controller offsets were mapped through the natural camera basis after that basis had already absorbed actor-owned HMD yaw, rotating fixed tracking-space hands a second time.

Weapons were intentionally not tested because UI, locomotion and body ownership already failed the run. The weapon wheel, optional HUD display and possible physical compass remain later interface work.
